mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports a biosynthetic/processing mechanism for PawL-derived cyclic orbitides involving precursor genes and asparaginyl endopeptidase-associated cyclization context; this is biosynthesis evidence, not antimicrobial killing mechanism evidence.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: PawL-derived peptides reported in this paper
mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct antimicrobial mechanism assay is reported for PLP killing or target engagement.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: NMR/LC-MS evidence supports cyclic peptide identity and structures for selected PLPs, including PLP-2 and PLP-12; it does not establish an antibacterial or antifungal mechanism because the activity assays were negative.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: PLP-2, PLP-4, PLP-10, PLP-12 structural subset
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote structural stability or scaffold potential to direct antimicrobial mechanism.

limitations: No primary-source direct antimicrobial mechanism assay was found; final mechanism remains context-only with negative activity cautions.
